items.title: Lemma 4.10: cancellation of closed immersions in a commutative triangle
items.statement_scope: Suppose given a commutative diagram in Top with maps X→Y, X→Z and Y→Z, where the maps X→Z and Y→Z are closed immersions of ∞-topoi. Then X→Y is a closed immersion of ∞-topoi. The whole statement and proof are retained.
items.difficulty_reason: Rule author-work-bearing-core-v1-20261114: the unit proves a concrete non-routine cancellation statement for closed immersions of ∞-topoi by reducing to closed subtopoi Z/U and Z/V and invoking Lemma A.A.5.11 (statement page 21; proof pages 21-22). A genuine technical step above routine qualification work.

difficulty_evidence.bearing_core: Cancellation of closed immersions via closed subtopoi and the equivalence X≃Y/g*U.
